using System;using System.Linq;using UnityEngine;using UnityEngine.UI;using CatGunner.Runtime;
public static class InspectMissionV5{public static object Main(){var c=GameClient.Instance;if(c==null||!Application.isPlaying)throw new Exception("Play required");return c.MissionUI.Mission_Item_UI_List.Select(i=>new{index=i.Mission_Index,vip=c.Missions.Catalogue.Missions[i.Mission_Index].is_VIP_Mission,vipName=i.VIP_Panel_obj!=null?i.VIP_Panel_obj.name:null,vipImages=i.VIP_Panel_obj!=null?i.VIP_Panel_obj.GetComponentsInChildren<Image>(true).Select(im=>new{im.name,color=ColorUtility.ToHtmlStringRGBA(im.color)}).ToArray():null,buttons=i.GetComponentsInChildren<Button>(true).Select(b=>new{b.name,alpha=b.colors.normalColor.a,color=b.GetComponent<Image>()!=null?ColorUtility.ToHtmlStringRGBA(b.GetComponent<Image>().color):null}).ToArray()}).ToArray();}}
